epoch_extension.request: User 2026-10-08: finish B/16 first and run it to 300 epochs; queue L/16 to at least 400 epochs; keep queue positions (no cancel/resubmit); evaluate along the way with separate single-GPU standard jobs.
epoch_extension.rule: resume_policy.validate_resume accepts an epochs increase only when run.py finds the matching target here, both configs use the constant LR schedule, and the checkpoint is not beyond the new target.
epoch_extension.paper_reference: Published FIDs exist for 200 and 600 epochs only; 300/400 summaries report status no_published_reference.
epoch_extension.milestones: run.py now keeps a checkpoint-NNN.pth hard link at every 100 epochs.
epoch_extension.b16_decision_2026_10_09: User 2026-10-09: B/16 stops at 200 epochs. The checkpoint saved during job 120736 records a 300-epoch target; resume_policy accepts the authorized lower target only because it equals the completed epoch, so no further B/16 training runs. The epoch-200 paper-protocol evaluation (120736, then follow-up 127599) is the final B/16 result and also writes summary.json.
epoch_extension.l16_decision_2026_10_09: User 2026-10-09: L/16 to 200 epochs as soon as possible (the published comparison point); the L/16 checkpoint already records a 200-epoch target, so no extension is needed. The target can be raised later without resubmitting.
epoch_extension.decision_20261009_b16_600: User 2026-10-09: "现在排队一个long的，等把b16跑到600epoch". B/16 continues from its 200-epoch checkpoint to 600 epochs (constant LR, so the schedule does not depend on the target) in a long-QoS eight-GPU job; the 200-epoch paper-protocol evaluation stays in summary-ep200.json.
